c.p: Which Iceni queen led a major rebellion against Roman rule in Britain in AD 60 or 61?
c.h: Her statues now stand near Westminster Pier in London.
c.e: Queen Boudicca led the Iceni tribe against Roman occupation, burning Camulodunum (Colchester) and Londinium.
r: Cleopatra was the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt.
Cartimandua was queen of the Brigantes who allied with Rome.
